setup.title: Set up your manager

console.copyFailed: This browser would not hand over the clipboard. Select the address and copy it.

settings.lazyLoadCharactersHint: Faster with a large library. A few extensions do not expect it.
settings.useDiskCacheHint: The next start does not have to read them all again.
settings.memoryCacheCapacityHint: More is faster and uses more RAM.
settings.requestCompressionHint: Worth having over a remote link or a slow network.
settings.extensionsHint: Turn off to find out whether an extension is what broke.
settings.extensionAutoUpdateHint: On start, whenever a release version changes.
settings.chatBackupsHint: SillyTavern keeps copies inside its own data folder.
settings.chatBackupCountHint: For each chat and each settings file.
settings.allowKeysExposure: Let stored keys be read back
settings.allowKeysExposureHint: On, SillyTavern can show a saved provider key again. Off, a key can only be typed in.

console.configFileHint: Every setting above is a line in this file. Change it in either place and the other follows.
console.saveChangesBody: SillyTavern restarts to pick them up.
console.configFileCaution: Only edit this if you know what it does
console.restoreDefaultsBody: The file goes back to the one this SillyTavern ships with. Everything in it now is lost.
console.restoreDefaultsDone: The configuration is back to its defaults.
console.useItInTabHint: Opens SillyTavern in a new tab.
console.previewWhenRunning: Start SillyTavern to use it here.

console.embedMinimizeHint: Back to the console. SillyTavern stays loaded, just as you left it.
console.embedZoomHint: Give SillyTavern the whole screen. The floating button brings the bar back.
console.embedResumeHint: Still loaded, just as you left it.
